description: Compares two views of content with an adjustable dividing line.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-compare position="50%" before-label="Before" after-label="After" style="height: 12rem;">
  <tp-box slot="before" style="height: 100%; background: var(--tp-neutral-100);">Before: the original design</tp-box>
  <tp-box slot="after" style="height: 100%; background: var(--tp-brand-100);">After: the updated design</tp-box>
</tp-compare>

attributes.name: after-label
attributes.description: Optional label for the after layer.

attributes.name: before-label
attributes.description: Optional label for the before layer.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Split direction: horizontal places the layers on the left and right; vertical places them above and below.

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Local persistence key for the position.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Resets the position to its initial value.

cssproperties.name: --tp-compare-divider-size
cssproperties.description: Thickness of the dividing line between the two layers.

cssproperties.name: --tp-compare-handle-size
cssproperties.description: Width and height of the draggable comparison handle.

cssproperties.name: --tp-compare-position
cssproperties.description: Position of the divider along the comparison axis, usually a percentage; synchronized with position and pointer or keyboard interaction.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-compare>` element compares two views of content with an adjustable dividing line.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Drag | Drag the comparison handle to reveal more of either image or panel. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Focus the comparison handle. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> | Moves the separator by 1%, or by 10% while <kbd>Shift</kbd> is held. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Moves the separator to its minimum or maximum position. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
